d:
Do you often feel tired, weak or less energetic than usual? Low iron can affect your stamina and may lead to anaemia if the deficiency becomes severe. Some warning signs, such as unusual cravings, restless legs, brittle nails or heavy menstrual bleeding, are easy to overlook.
In this video, Hansaji explains the difference between iron deficiency and anaemia, common signs to watch for, and practical ways to support healthy iron levels through
food, lifestyle and yoga.
What you will learn:
1. Why low iron and anaemia are not the same.
